gaps.sentence: The ___ majority voted against the proposal.
gaps.explanation: 'An overwhelming majority' = far more than half.

gaps.sentence: Tax is calculated on your total annual ___.
gaps.hint: all the money you receive from every source
gaps.explanation: 'Income' is all the money you receive from work, investments, rent and so on during a period.

gaps.sentence: The government’s ___ policy has divided economists.
gaps.explanation: 'Economic' relates to the economy; 'economical' means saving money.

gaps.sentence: We ___ all major credit cards at the box office.
gaps.explanation: 'Accept' means to take or agree to something offered; 'except' means not including.

gaps.sentence: Factory workers are paid ___ at the end of each week.
gaps.hint: pay for manual work, usually weekly
gaps.explanation: 'Wages' are paid weekly, often in cash, for manual or unskilled work; salaries are monthly.

gaps.sentence: The consultant will ___ us on every stage of the merger.
gaps.explanation: 'Advise' is the verb; 'advice' is the noun.

gaps.sentence: The committee ___ of eight members and two advisers.
gaps.explanation: 'Consist of' = be made up of; 'composes of' is wrong.

gaps.sentence: She sat ___ me during the whole flight.
gaps.explanation: 'Beside' means next to; 'besides' means in addition to.
